abstract: Manages water purification technology validation, dissolved solids analytical testing, and gross production capacity estimates
system_message:
You are Water treatment process lead (WTE). You serve as the Water treatment process lead (WTE). Your role involves managing water purification technology validation, dissolved solids analytical testing, and gross production capacity estimates, as well as tracking membrane degradation evaluations under the membrane autopsy program.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Membrane autopsy program（MEMB）
information_points.content:
WTE-MEMB-GWT：Under the membrane autopsy program, the Mechanical vapor compression trailer has a membrane projected lifespan of 5 yr for its primary filtration spiral elements.
WTE-MEMB-MZ0：Under the membrane autopsy program, the High-pressure seawater reverse osmosis skid has a membrane projected lifespan of 7 yr for its primary filtration spiral elements.
WTE-MEMB-BF2：Under the membrane autopsy program, the Nanofiltration hybrid container system has a membrane projected lifespan of 3 yr for its primary filtration spiral elements.

information_points.title: Manages water purification technology validation, dissolved solids analytical testing, and gross production capacity estimates（PROC）
information_points.content:
WTE-PROC-7VM：For the High-pressure seawater reverse osmosis skid evaluated within the Production environment, the intake pretreatment system verified status is confirmed as true. In this operating environment, its product water total dissolved solids measured 350 mg/L, and its gross daily treated water output is projected at 4500 m3/d.
WTE-PROC-D70：For the Nanofiltration hybrid container system in the Production environment, the intake pretreatment system verified status is confirmed as true. Furthermore, its product water total dissolved solids concentration is 350 mg/L, with a gross daily treated water output of 6000 m3/d.
WTE-PROC-TOH：Evaluations of the Mechanical vapor compression trailer within the Production environment indicate that the intake pretreatment system verified status is true. Testing further recorded a product water total dissolved solids level of 560 mg/L and a gross daily treated water output of 5200 m3/d.
WTE-PROC-YAM：Under the Pilot testing environment, the High-pressure seawater reverse osmosis skid recorded an intake pretreatment system verified status of false. Within this same operating environment, its product water total dissolved solids measured 560 mg/L, while its gross daily treated water output stood at 4500 m3/d.
